HTSUS heading 1302 covers vegetable saps and extracts, including "other" extracts under 1302.19. This product is a glycerin-water liquid extract of botanicals, so 1302.19 is the natural fit.

Subheading 1302.19 splits into 1302.19.05 (medicinal use, for the Pharmaceutical Appendix), 1302.19.15 (containing mixtures of vegetable extracts) and 1302.19.40 (other). Under 1302.19.91 and similar lines, the 10-digit statistical suffix varies by item. I recall these lines as:
- 1302.19.05: Medicinal use, 00.
- 1302.19.15: Other, 00 (?).
- 1302.19.40: Other, 00 (?).
- 1302.19.91: Other, 00.

The AD/CVD case on herbal tincture extracts is a recent one. The tinctures are intended as herbal supplements, so a medicinal-use line is plausible. However, the glycerin-water solvent mixture suggests the subheading "other" may be more appropriate.

I settled on 1302.19.9190 as my best guess for "other" vegetable extracts, though I'm not certain of the exact suffix.
